Headline: #22 Clark Temporary Northbound Reroute near Clark/Ashland-Arthur
ShortDescription: Northbound #22 Clark buses are temporarily rerouted due to, street blockage near Clark/Ashland-Arthur.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #22 Clark buses are temporarily rerouted via Clark, Devon, Ridge, Pratt, and Clark then resume their normal route due to, street blockage near Clark/Ashland-Arthur.

Southbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
